create_Sequence_space: create a Sequence space with a name and optional size_range and dtype parameters
check_Sequence_contains: check if a Sequence space contains a given value using the contains method
compare_Sequence_equality: compare two Sequence spaces for equality using the __eq__ method
repr_Sequence_space: get a string representation of a Sequence space using the __repr__ method
create_Sequence_with_scalar_range: create a Sequence space with a scalar_range to enforce element value bounds
